transcript: Speaker A: We have lots and lots of imaginations of all the things that we can do. If we just didn't have to type anymore, we could go and do those things. And so maybe it's just because in the last 50 years, this one little device with a keyboard on it consumed all of our lives to the point where we just can't imagine living without typing anymore. Speaker B: The magic that Wispr Flow really comes from the fact that it doesn't transcribe what you're saying word for word. It actually understands what you're trying to communicate and then puts that down. If I say, 'Hey Sean, let's meet at 5:00. Actually, you know what, let's do 6:00 p.m.' Wispr will write, 'Hey Sean, let's meet at 6:00 p.m.' It lets you speak and ramble, and it puts everything down in the most structured and concise way that makes you feel understood.
